name: Phase Noise Handling in Amplitude-Only SLMs
aliases: Phase Noise Mitigation in Amplitude-Only SLMs
Phase noise handling in amplitude-only SLMs
definition: A technique to model and mitigate phase noise caused by the inherent properties of liquid crystals in amplitude-only SLMs, using Jacobi-Anger expansion and Fourier series.
summary: Phase Noise Handling in Amplitude-Only SLMs models phase-amplitude coupling to derive grating frequency constraints that prevent noise overlap, distinguishing itself through rigorous analytical derivation rather than empirical averaging.
